task: Book an appointment with Dr. Lee for any available time. Use the name Alex Doe and the email alex@example.com.
summary: I reached the booking form and filled in the doctor, date, name and email, but I could not book: the available times are announced as plain text and cannot be reached with Tab or activated, so no time can be chosen. When I submitted anyway, the error "Please choose a time slot" appeared silently, without being announced. Several controls (doctor list, email field, submit button, two navigation links) have no accessible name, so I had to guess. The most important fix is to turn the time slots into a native radio group inside a fieldset with a legend.

steps.reason: I hear link "Book an appointment" in the main content; it should open the booking form.

issues.title: Link has no accessible name
issues.description: 2 links on "Maple Grove Clinic - Family care in your neighborhood" are announced only as "link", with no name. A screen reader user cannot tell what they do. The same problem is also on "Book an appointment - Maple Grove Clinic".
issues.fix: Add text to the link, or an aria-label for icon-only links:

issues.title: Heading levels skip
issues.description: The heading "Our doctors" is level 4 but follows a level 1 heading. Screen reader users navigate by headings and may think content is missing.
issues.fix: Use heading levels in order. Change it to <h2> and style it with CSS if it should look smaller.

issues.title: Images have no text alternative
issues.description: 1 image on "Maple Grove Clinic - Family care in your neighborhood" has no alt attribute. Screen readers announce them as "image" or read the file name. The same problem is also on "Book an appointment - Maple Grove Clinic".
issues.fix: Describe meaningful images, and mark decorative ones as empty:

issues.title: Navigation link has no name
issues.description: In the main navigation, after "Home" and "Doctors", the screen reader only says "link". I cannot know where it goes; it might be the booking page, but I have to guess. The site logo link at the top is also announced as just "link".

issues.title: Drop-down list has no label
issues.description: 1 combobox on "Book an appointment - Maple Grove Clinic" is announced only as "combobox", with no name. A screen reader user cannot tell what it does.
issues.fix:
Associate a label with the select element:
<label for="doctor">Doctor</label>
<select id="doctor">…</select>

issues.title: Text field has no label
issues.description: 1 textbox on "Book an appointment - Maple Grove Clinic" is announced only as "textbox", with no name. A screen reader user cannot tell what it does.
issues.fix:
Associate a visible label with the field:
<label for="email">Email</label>
<input id="email" type="email" autocomplete="email">

issues.title: Button has no accessible name
issues.description: 1 button on "Book an appointment - Maple Grove Clinic" is announced only as "button", with no name. A screen reader user cannot tell what it does.
issues.fix:
Give the button visible text, or an aria-label when it only contains an icon:
<button aria-label="Close"><svg aria-hidden="true">…</svg></button>

issues.title: Clickable elements cannot be reached or activated with a screen reader or keyboard
issues.description: 5 elements on "Book an appointment - Maple Grove Clinic" react to mouse clicks but are not buttons, links or form controls (for example "9:00", "10:30", "14:00", "16:15"). Screen readers announce them as plain text and keyboard users cannot focus them.
issues.fix:
Use a native control instead of a clickable <div>. For a choice between options, a radio group:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Available times</legend>
  <input type="radio" id="t1" name="time" value="09:00"><label for="t1">9:00</label>
</fieldset>
For an action: <button type="button">…</button>

issues.title: Fields use a placeholder instead of a label
issues.description: 1 field on "Book an appointment - Maple Grove Clinic" only have placeholder text ("Full name"). It disappears while typing and is not reliably announced by every screen reader.
issues.fix:
Keep the placeholder as a hint if you like, but add a real label:
<label for="name">Full name</label>
<input id="name" autocomplete="name">

element.name: Full name
element.html: <input class="input" type="text" id="name" name="name" placeholder="Full name" autocomplete="name">

issues.title: Doctor drop-down has no label
issues.description: The first form control is announced only as "combobox". The word "Doctor" is read just before it as plain text, but it is not connected to the list, so when I tab to the field I only hear "combobox, Choose a doctor". I guessed its purpose from the options.

issues.title: Time slots cannot be selected
issues.description: After "Available times" the screen reader only reads plain text: 9:00, 10:30, 11:45, 14:00, 16:15. None of them is a button, radio button or link, and pressing Tab jumps from the date field straight to "Full name". A screen reader or keyboard user has no way to choose a time, so the appointment cannot be booked.
issues.fix:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Available times</legend>
  <input type="radio" id="t0900" name="time" value="09:00"><label for="t0900">9:00</label>
  <input type="radio" id="t1145" name="time" value="11:45" disabled><label for="t1145">11:45 (taken)</label>
</fieldset>

issues.title: Taken time slots are only shown visually
issues.description: The page says "Crossed-out times are already taken", but nothing in what the screen reader announces tells me which times are crossed out. Even if I could select a time, I would not know which ones are available.
issues.fix: Mark unavailable slots in the markup, not only with styling: <input type="radio" … disabled> with label "11:45 (taken)", or aria-disabled="true" plus visually hidden text.

issues.title: Email field has no label
issues.description: The field after "Full name" is announced only as "edit text" with no name. The word "Email" is read just before it as plain text, so I guessed, but when tabbing into the field nothing tells me what to type.

issues.title: Validation error is not announced
issues.description: When I pressed the submit button, the screen reader said nothing except that focus was on the button. The message "Please choose a time slot." was added to the page silently; I only found it by reading the whole page again. A screen reader user would think the button did nothing.

issues.title: Submit button has no name
issues.description: The form's only button is announced as just "button". The text "Book appointment" is read before it as separate text, so I had to guess that this button submits the booking.
